about_page.tagline: Seeds That Deliver Trust, Yield, and Growth
about_page.whoWeArePara1: We are a leading seed company specializing in research, trade, and marketing of high-quality hybrid and open pollination seeds. Our main goal is to empower farmers with advanced, reliable, and high-performing seed varieties that ensure better yield, improved quality, and sustainable farming.
about_page.whoWeArePara2: Cassia Seed Private Limited is a professional research, trade, and marketing company dedicated to improving agricultural productivity. We focus on the research and development of superior hybrid and open pollination vegetable seed varieties that meet the needs of modern farming and ensure consistent growth.
about_page.rdBody: Creating high-yielding, disease-resistant, and climate-tolerant seed varieties.
about_page.tradingBody: Importing, locally producing, and distributing premium hybrid and open pollination vegetable seeds to farmers and dealers nationwide.
about_page.marketingBody: Farmer meetings, expert guidance, field demonstrations, and marketing support to ensure farmers benefit from our innovations.
about_page.commitmentBody: We are committed to delivering seeds that farmers can trust. With advanced research facilities, strict quality control, and strong distribution networks, we help farmers increase productivity and profitability.
about_page.visionBody: To be the preferred partners in agriculture, driving growth through innovation, sustainability, and excellence, while creating enduring value for farmers, communities, and stakeholders.
about_page.missionBody: Empowering farmers and communities through high-quality seed solutions and sustainable agricultural growth.
about_page.historyH2: From a humble shop to a national seed company
about_page.historyBody1: Our journey began in 1985 — not as a corporate launch, but as a humble local agricultural seed shop. For forty intense years, our founder poured his dedication into this small business. He didn't just sell seeds; he built trust. Through hard work, deep market knowledge, and an unwavering focus on quality, the shop grew its reputation exponentially, evolving from a local dealer into a recognized, reliable supplier and distributor across the region.
about_page.historyBody2: In 2022, that personal vision transformed into the formal establishment of Cassia Seed Private Limited — a pivotal moment that ushered in a new chapter focused on scaling impact. Today, the company operates as a key importer and local producer of high-quality vegetable seeds, leveraging global expertise and local production capabilities to drive sustainable growth of Pakistan's agriculture sector.
about_page.historyQuote: Grow with confidence. Grow with Cassia Seed Private Limited.
about_page.storyBody: Started in 1985 as a local seed shop, formally incorporated in 2022 as Cassia Seed Private Limited — dedicated to empowering Pakistan's farmers with the best seed varieties.
